captions.detailed: This is a realistic model of a historic field cannon. It features a dark grey cylindrical barrel with visible trunnions, supported on a brown wooden two-wheel carriage with thin spokes. The carriage extends backward into two long trail supports, giving it a stable, authentic artillery design. The barrel is mounted to allow vertical elevation articulation relative to the carriage.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic field cannon model with a thick dark grey barrel, visible trunnions, and a sturdy two-wheel wooden carriage with rear trail supports. The barrel should be jointed to articulate in pitch (elevation) relative to the carriage assembly.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining materials for the wooden carriage (brown) and the metal barrel/axles (dark grey). It builds the carriage using Box shapes for the main trail frames and Cylinder primitives for the wheels, spokes, and axle. The barrel is modeled as a stepped cylinder with trunnions, which is then attached to the carriage via a revolute joint to enable elevation movement.
